entities.name: Plains of Oneah
entities.description: Plains in the center of the island of Oneah in the Domains, also called the Plain of Suns, once home to the Seven Cities of the Sun.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Island in the Domains and nation whose heartland was the Plains.

entities.name: Seven Cities of the Sun
entities.description: The heartland cities of the nation of Oneah, which fell to the goblins.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Hordes from the Red Mountains who destroyed the Cities of the Sun.

entities.name: Goblin War
entities.description: A lengthy war preceding the goblin swarming in 4165.

entities.name: Red Mountains
entities.description: Mountains ringing the plains, where goblin warrens lay.

entities.name: The Domains
entities.description: Region containing the island of Oneah.

events.summary: In 4165, after the Goblin War, goblins swarm from the Red Mountains and fill the plains with bloodshed.
events.quote: goblins swarmed from their warrens in the Red Mountains

events.summary: The Cities of the Sun fall one by one and survivors flee, never to return.
events.quote: One by one, the Cities of the Sun fell to the rampaging hordes.

relations.note: In the central part of the island.
relations.quote: in the central part of the island of Oneah
the Cities of the Sun fell to the rampaging hordes
